units.full: Encourage clear liquids up to 2 hours before induction to prevent dehydration and perioperative hypoglycaemia; do not keep healthy elective patients nil by mouth from midnight unnecessarily. Never delay emergency surgery solely to satisfy elective fasting intervals: treat the patient as having a full stomach and use rapid-sequence induction when indicated.
